Class TestResourcesLogMirror

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.testresources.TestResourcesLogMirror
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class TestResourcesLogMirror extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Tails a Test Resources server's log files and reports the lines that explain a wait: image pulls, container creation, container startup and errors.

The server runs in its own process and logs to a file, so the wait it causes is invisible to whichever process is blocked on it. Only the process that owns the terminal may write to it — a second writer tears a live progress region and its lines are repainted away — so the mirror is started by the launcher that is waiting and its lines are handed to that launcher's reporter through the sink.

The CLI passes the resolved log directory in "PYRONAUT_TEST_RESOURCES_LOGS_DIR"; start(Consumer) does nothing when that is absent, which is the case for a run without Test Resources.

      public static TestResourcesLogMirror watch(Path logsDirectory, Consumer<TestResourcesLogMirror.Entry> sink)
      Note where the log files currently end without reporting anything yet. A caller that is about to start the server watches first, so that what the server logs while starting is reported once start() runs.
      Parameters:
      logsDirectory - the server's log directory, or null for no mirroring
      sink - receives each mirrored line
      Returns:
      the mirror, not yet reporting
